dataset.provenance: Original author-written regression cases developed alongside context-screening-v1. Not a held-out benchmark. Semantic threshold -1 forces all candidates through admission; lexical queries use an explicit Orion marker. Includes known remaining limits.

limitations: Measures context exposure and retention, not agent attack success or executed actions.
Dataset labels and sampling are supplied by the author; rates do not establish population guarantees.
Text-only and unfiltered methods are minimal ablations, not tuned or LLM-based defenses.
Stable case-ID ties differ from production UUID ties; timing is not measured.
Fresh engine instances share one in-memory store; this is not a process-restart durability test.
